qa.q: What do you usually do on the weekend?
qa.a: Normally it's just a case of sleeping and recovering from all the work and working out during the week. Um, so I get to have a lie-in on Saturday, and then I can, oh, I can study and I can have brunch, um, as opposed to breakfast. So, it's, um, those are the big things, and then usually I get to see my friends in the evening.

qa.q: Do you like to work on the weekends?
qa.a: Well, I used to, but now I study and um, see my friends. It's a lot less frenetic and more relaxing than before.

qa.q: Do you feel that weekends now are more important to you than when you were a child?
qa.a: Um, probably. I think now I realize how limited the time is, um, and when you're younger, you kind of take the weekend for granted, don't you? So, yes, definitely. Um, and I think most people realize that when they're older as well.

qa.q: What would your ideal weekend be like?
qa.a: Um, well, I feel like they're already ideal to be honest, because I, I spend all morning in bed basically, and then I'll wake up and work out, and I'll have brunch or lunch, and then I'll go shopping. Um, and then I can study, and I get to see my friends in the evening, like I said, so it works out fairly well for me.

qa.q: Is it important to make the most out of your weekend?
qa.a: Oh, yeah, 100%. I, I actually feel quite strongly about this. Um, I don't like wasting time on frivolous nonsense at weekends. Um, and it's important to make the best use of the time that you have. I don't think anybody goes to their deathbed wishing they'd spent more time at work. Like, oh, I wish I'd spent more time in the office rather than hanging out with my friends or doing something fun with my family at the weekend.

qa.q: Which is your favorite part of the weekend?
qa.a: I think probably early afternoon on Saturday. I guess that's when I look and feel my best, probably, after I sleep and finish the gym.

qa.q: Do you think your weekends are long enough?
qa.a: Um, well, basically, yes. Although I think everybody wants more time, don't they? Um, the odd long weekend probably wouldn't go amiss, but the two and a half days that I usually get is quite fine and then I can go back to work. So it's not such a big deal.

qa.q: How important do you think it is to have free time on the weekends?
qa.a: Well, it's, it's essential for the reasons that I mentioned, isn't it? Um, I think that you're supposed to use this week, like, use this time to relax, aren't you? So it's, it's really important, isn't it?

qa.q: In your country, do men and women usually do the same kind of things on the weekends?
qa.a: Um, probably, yes. Um, before the whole hoo-ha with the pandemic, most people went out and spent time with their friends and family. I don't think there's a big difference between what men and women did. Um, maybe in terms of activities, like women would be more likely to get a manicure or something. But, um, I think most people just want to have a nice time at the weekend.

qa.q: Why do you think many people consider the weekend to be important?
qa.a: Um, well, it's important to have this kind of intermission between workweeks, otherwise they all blur into one and that can really stress you out. Um, I think it's also an important escape from the daily grind, more broadly speaking.

qa.q: What are you going to do next weekend?
qa.a: Well, that's a good question. Um, if I feel better then I'll go out with my friends. But if not then, uh, I suppose I'd better stay home and study.
